scope: Existing Phase 0 smartphone/VBOX pairs; audit copies are not independent sequences.
policy: No pair is approved for Phase 2. Preserve duplicate/overlap-linked complete recordings in one split group. Conditional candidates still need physical frame and IMU-label alignment validation; no per-test-sequence fitted lags may be imported.
unpaired_recordings: Not approved for supervised VBOX velocity labels without separately verified reference correspondence.
